tiles.title: Requests
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS requests
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')

tiles.title: Trace Error Rate
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT span_trace_id FROM $trace_dataset WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')
), errors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT span_trace_id FROM $trace_dataset
  WHERE span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL OR "error.message" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.span_trace_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.span_trace_id END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT r.span_trace_id), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM requests r LEFT JOIN errors e ON r.span_trace_id = e.span_trace_id

tiles.title: Total Tokens
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE) + CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS total_tokens
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat'

tiles.title: Total Spend
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE))), 0), 8) AS spend_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Avg Request Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_latency_s
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')

tiles.title: P95 Request Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_latency_s
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')

tiles.title: P95 Time to First Token
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont("gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk", 0.95), 4) AS p95_ttft_s
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat' AND "gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk" IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Request Volume by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  COUNT(DISTINCT span_trace_id) AS requests
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')
GROUP BY time_bin, model
ORDER BY time_bin ASC, model ASC

tiles.title: Proxy Request Rate by Model & Status
Trace Errors Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE("error.type", span_status_description, 'unknown') AS error_type,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE (span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL OR "error.message" IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY time_bin, error_type
ORDER BY time_bin ASC, error_type ASC

tiles.title: Trace Request Latency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.50), 3) AS p50_s,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.99), 3) AS p99_s
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')

ORDER BY time_bin ASC

tiles.title: Latency by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  COUNT(*) AS requests,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_s,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s,
  ROUND(MAX(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS max_s
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')

ORDER BY p95_s DESC

tiles.title: Output Tokens

tiles.title: Cost by Model Over Time

tiles.title: Cost by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  ROUND(SUM("litellm.cost.total"), 8) AS cost_usd

WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat'
GROUP BY model

tiles.title: Provider Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') AS provider,

tiles.title: Finish Reasons
tiles.chartQuery:

  COUNT(*) AS calls

tiles.title: Model Performance & Cost
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') AS provider,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  COUNT(*) AS calls,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 4) AS avg_latency_s,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 4) AS p95_latency_s,
  SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.total_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE)) AS total_tokens,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE("litellm.cost.total", 0)), 8) AS cost_usd
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat'
GROUP BY provider, model
ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Service & SDK Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service,
  COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') AS environment,
  COALESCE("telemetry.sdk.language", 'unknown') AS language,
  COALESCE("telemetry.sdk.name", 'unknown') AS sdk,
  COALESCE("telemetry.sdk.version", 'unknown') AS sdk_version,
  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $trace_dataset
GROUP BY service, environment, language, sdk, sdk_version
ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Streaming vs Non-streaming
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE("litellm.request.streaming", "llm.is_streaming", false) THEN 'streaming' ELSE 'non-streaming' END AS mode,
  COUNT(*) AS calls
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat'
GROUP BY mode
ORDER BY calls DESC

tiles.title: Recent Request Traces
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH requests AS (
  SELECT p_timestamp AS start_time, span_trace_id,
    COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS requested_model,
    ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 4) AS duration_s,
    span_status_code
  FROM $trace_dataset WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')
), llm AS (
  SELECT span_trace_id,
    MAX("gen_ai.provider.name") AS provider,
    MAX(COALESCE("gen_ai.response.model", "gen_ai.request.model")) AS response_model,
    SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens,
    SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens,
    ROUND(SUM(COALESCE("litellm.cost.total", 0)), 8) AS cost_usd,
    MAX(span_status_code) AS llm_status
  FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat' GROUP BY span_trace_id
)
SELECT r.start_time, r.span_trace_id, r.requested_model, l.provider, l.response_model,
  r.duration_s, COALESCE(l.input_tokens, 0) AS input_tokens,
  COALESCE(l.output_tokens, 0) AS output_tokens,
  COALESCE(l.cost_usd, 0) AS cost_usd,
  CASE WHEN GREATEST(r.span_status_code, COALESCE(l.llm_status, 0)) = 2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS status
FROM requests r LEFT JOIN llm l ON r.span_trace_id = l.span_trace_id
ORDER BY r.start_time DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent LLM Calls
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') AS provider,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 5) AS duration_s,
  ROUND("gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk", 5) AS ttft_s,
  CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens,
  CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens", '0') AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens,
  ROUND(COALESCE("litellm.cost.total", 0), 8) AS cost_usd,
  span_status_description, "error.type" AS error_type
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "gen_ai.operation.name" = 'chat'
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Errors
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_name,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') AS provider,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 4) AS duration_s,
  COALESCE("error.type", "event_exception.type", span_status_description, 'unknown') AS error_type,
  COALESCE("error.message", "event_exception.message", span_status_message, 'unknown') AS error_message
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE span_status_code = 2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL OR "error.message" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Slowest Requests
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  COALESCE("http.route", "http.target", 'unknown') AS route,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 4) AS duration_s,
  span_status_description
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE ("gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL)
  AND ("http.route" IS NOT NULL OR "http.target" IS NOT NULL)
  AND (span_parent_span_id IS NULL OR span_parent_span_id = '')
ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Recent Span Timeline Data
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_parent_span_id, span_name,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.operation.name", 'http') AS operation,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", "gen_ai.response.model", 'unknown') AS model,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 3) AS duration_ms,
  span_status_description
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC, span_start_time_unix_nano ASC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Estimated Cost (agent_cost)
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 0), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Recorded Cost
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Average Cost per Request
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE))), 6) AS avg_cost_per_request_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Pricing Coverage
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pricing_coverage_pct FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL

tiles.title: Estimated Cost Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Estimated vs Recorded Cost
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('$bucket_size', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE))), 6) AS resolved_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Estimated Cost by Model
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NOT NULL) AS priced_requests, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "gen_ai.request.model" ORDER BY estimated_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST

tiles.title: Model Cost Efficiency
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "gen_ai.provider.name" AS provider, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NOT NULL) AS priced_requests, SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens, SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens, ROUND(SUM(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp)), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE))), 6) AS avg_cost_per_request_usd, ROUND(1000.0 * SUM(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE))) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE) + CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE)), 0), 6) AS cost_per_1k_tokens_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "gen_ai.provider.name", "gen_ai.request.model" ORDER BY estimated_cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST

tiles.title: Unpriced Models
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "gen_ai.provider.name" AS provider, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COUNT(*) AS unpriced_requests, SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE)) AS input_tokens, SUM(CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE)) AS output_tokens, ROUND(SUM(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL AND agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp) IS NULL GROUP BY "gen_ai.provider.name", "gen_ai.request.model" ORDER BY unpriced_requests DESC

tiles.title: Most Expensive Requests
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, "gen_ai.provider.name" AS provider, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens, CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens, ROUND(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), 6) AS estimated_cost_usd, ROUND(CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE), 6) AS recorded_cost_usd, ROUND(COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)), 6) AS resolved_cost_usd, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s FROM $trace_dataset WHERE span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(agent_cost(LOWER("gen_ai.provider.name"), "gen_ai.request.model", CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.prompt_tokens") AS DOUBLE), CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", "gen_ai.usage.completion_tokens") AS DOUBLE), p_timestamp), CAST("litellm.cost.total" AS DOUBLE)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY resolved_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 50
